latest_release.body:
## tvOS Beta 3.5.3

> **Install:** [NuvioTV-3.5.3-unsigned-release.ipa](https://github.com/bobsupra/NuvioTVOS/releases/download/tvos-beta-3.5.3/NuvioTV-3.5.3-unsigned-release.ipa) requires a compatible tvOS development or sideloading signing workflow before installation.

> **New beta alerts:** [Manage notifications](https://github.com/bobsupra/NuvioTVOS/subscription) → choose **Custom → Releases** · [Report a bug or suggest an idea](https://github.com/bobsupra/NuvioTVOS/issues/new/choose)

> **Join the community:** [NuvioTVOS Discord](https://discord.gg/2YnNr2xmnJ) — chat, get help, report bugs, and share ideas.

### Native IPTV & Electronic Programme Guide (EPG)

- **Browsable Programme Guide:** Added a full native Electronic Programme Guide (EPG) grid with multi-feed loading, channel categories, and programme timelines.
- **Multi-Feed Guide Merging:** Intelligently aggregates and synchronizes schedule data from multiple XMLTV guide feeds.
- **Per-Source Channel Preferences:** Configure, order, and toggle channel visibility individually per configured IPTV source.
- **Settings Toggle:** Enabled in **Settings → Live TV** to display the dedicated **Live TV** tab in the main navigation.

### Plex Media Server Multi-Library Scalability

- **Server Sync Limit Partitioning:** Shared 150,000-item ceiling across all libraries of a server, preventing high memory peaks and unexpected terminations on massive libraries.
- **Per-Library Storage Serialization:** Each library is saved to its own isolated file on a background serial queue, keeping the main actor fluid. Automatically migrates older monolithic files on first launch.
- **Connection Retry Resilience:** Automatic request retries (up to 2x) for server page queries that experience network timeouts or socket disconnects.
- **On-Demand Title Refresh:** Automatically queries for newly added media when opening a stream list.

### Anime & Metadata Discovery (AniList, MyAnimeList & Kitsu)

- **Community Reviews:** Read user reviews and critiques from AniList and MyAnimeList directly inside the anime Details screen.
- **Contextual Search Menu:** Long-press on any catalog card to trigger instant **"Find on AniList / MyAnimeList / Kitsu"**.
- **Native Kitsu & MAL Titles:** Open titles from Kitsu and MyAnimeList using their native metadata, localized titles, and cover artwork.
- **Voice Actor Filmographies:** View voice actor profiles and related roles directly from AniList cast cards.
- **Season Chains & Clean Tabs:** Formats merged season tabs cleanly as `"Season N"`, preserves subsequent seasons after movie entries in One Title, and stabilizes background backdrop blur.
- **Asynchronous Ratings:** Preserves rating badges as they arrive in the background without layout shift.

### Core Animation & Navigation Smoothness (PR #463)

- **Core Animation Engine:** Details screen, catalog rows, Home rows, and the episode strip are now driven by Core Animation for fluid, stutter-free navigation.
- **Row Title Alignment:** The active card remains positioned directly beneath the row title, scrolled natively by the tvOS Focus Engine.
- **Memory Leak Fix:** Resolved an issue where tab switches leaked ~40 MB of memory per switch.
- **Focus Outlines & Restoration:** Restored consistent tvOS focus borders and reliable focus restoration across Details and Home.

### Playback Engine, Usenet & Subtitles

- **Usenet Read-Ahead Caching:** Prefetches stream chunks to disk so scrubbing or jumping forward into Usenet media begins immediately with zero buffering stalls.
- **Dynamic Subtitle Language Upgrades:** Automatically promotes playback to a higher-ranked subtitle language if one arrives late from an add-on.
- **MPVKit Polish:**
  - Buffered indicator accurately reflects the exact cache boundary.
  - Track lists only rebuild when track inventory changes.
  - Live streams remain open beyond 5 minutes without premature disconnects.
  - Playback continues seamlessly during Control Center or Siri overlays.

detail.readme:
Chat, get help, report bugs, and share feature ideas.



Nuvio TV for tvOS

A modern Apple TV media player for browsing catalogs and playing user-configured sources.
SwiftUI tvOS shell - catalog browsing - AetherEngine / MPVKit playback

Download the latest Apple TV `.ipa` from [Releases](https://github.com/bobsupra/NuvioTVOS/releases), then sideload it with Xcode, Apple Configurator, or your preferred tool. See the release notes for known issues. > **AltStore / SideStore / Feather Source:** Add `https://raw.githubusercontent.com/bobsupra/NuvioTVOS/main/apps.json` · [Add to AltStore](altstore://source?url=https://raw.githubusercontent.com/bobsupra/NuvioTVOS/main/apps.json) · [Add to SideStore](sidestore://source?url=https://raw.githubusercontent.com/bobsupra/NuvioTVOS/main/apps.json) > **New beta alerts:** [Manage notifications](https://github.com/bobsupra/NuvioTVOS/subscription) → choose **Custom → Releases**. ## Latest tvOS Beta **Beta 3.5.3** is the latest tvOS release. [Quick download (.ipa)](https://github.com/bobsupra/NuvioTVOS/releases/download/tvos-beta-3.5.3/NuvioTV-3.5.3-unsigned-release.ipa) · [Read the release notes](https://github.com/bobsupra/NuvioTVOS/releases/tag/tvos-beta-3.5.3) · [Report a bug or suggest an idea](https://github.com/bobsupra/NuvioTVOS/issues/new/choose) The IPA requires a compatible tvOS development or sideloading signing workflow before installation. ### New in Beta 3.5.3 - **Native IPTV & Programme Guide (EPG):** Full browsable live TV guide grid, multi-feed XMLTV merging, and per-source channel preferences. - **Plex Multi-Library Scalability:** Shared 150k-item server limit preventing high memory usage, isolated per-library saves on serial background queues, and connection timeout retries. - **Anime & Metadata Discovery (AniList, MAL & Kitsu):** User reviews in anime details, long-press card menu ("Find on AniList / MAL / Kitsu"), native metadata for Kitsu and MAL, voice actor pages, and clean season chains. - **Core Animation Smoothness:** Details, catalog rows, Home rows, and episode strips migrated to Core Animation with locked title alignment; focus outline restoration and tab switch memory leak fix. - **Playback, Usenet & Subtitles:** Usenet read-ahead disk cache for zero-stall forward skipping, dynamic add-on subtitle upgrade, MPVKit cache-accurate bar and Siri/Control Center overlay retention, and official stream badges. - **AIOStreams & Plugins (r2):** Removed 15-addon limit, preserved plugin Usenet streams, configurable Node.js memory limits, and ARMv8.0 V8 snapshot. - **Authentication & Profiles:** Sign in with short device code, sign-out confirmation dialog, restored sidebar profile switcher, and diagnostic URL redaction. ### Built-in Player Nuvio's free built-in **AetherEngine** is the default in Auto mode. **MPVKit** is the one-way fallback, and either engine can be selected in Settings. - **Playback:** Native tvOS and Siri Remote controls, precise seeking and resume, saved audio and subtitle tracks, audio delay, frame-rate and dynamic-range matching, direct HTTPS and HLS streams, and custom HTTP headers. - **Video:** HDR10, HDR10+, HLG, Dolby Vision P5/P8, experimental full Dolby Vision P7 FEL, and optional MetalFX upscaling of sub-1080p SDR toward the display's resolution, with VideoToolbox/Neural Engine super-resolution when supported on compatible devices running tvOS 27.1+. - **Audio:** Dolby Atmos passthrough (E-AC3+JOC), channel fold-down, night-mode compression, and up to +12 dB dialogue lift with peak limiting. The optional lossless audio bridge converts supported non-streamable surround audio (TrueHD, DTS-HD MA, Opus) to up to 7.1-channel LPCM (24-bit for lossless sources; lossy inputs may be 16-bit) for compatible AVRs and eARC soundbars. When disabled, multichannel audio is bridged to Dolby Digital Plus with up to 5.1 channels for ARC compatibility. - **Subtitles and seeking:** Embedded and add-on text/PGS subtitles, authored ASS/SSA through AetherEngine's custom renderer, and thumbnail previews while scrubbing. Optional Seekr storyboards provide extra preview frames when configured. MPVKit handles separate audio/video URLs, audio amplification, and complex ASS/SSA typesetting. For supported 48 kHz TrueHD Atmos and DTS:X VOD, **Settings → Playback → Player → Atmos & DTS:X Spatial Audio (Beta)** opts into a fixed 9.1.6 render on tvOS 26+. It is off by default. The engine delivers 24-bit PCM to the system for HDMI and AirPods Spatial Audio, or lossy APAC for AirPlay; this is not TrueHD or DTS-HD bitstream passthrough. See [the spatial audio notes](docs/truehd-spatial-audio.md) for supported sources and fallback behavior. ### Supported Media Servers & Sources [Plex](https://plex.tv) · [Jellyfin](https://jellyfin.org) · Live TV (IPTV / M3U) · SMB (NAS / Network Shares) · [Usenet (NNTP)](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Usenet) · [AIOStreams](https://github.com/Viren070/AIOStreams) · [Stremio Add-ons](https://stremio.com) ### Supported Tracking Services [Trakt](https://trakt.tv) · [Simkl](https://simkl.com) · [AniList](https://anilist.co) · [MyAnimeList](https://myanimelist.net) · [WeTrakr](https://wetrakr.com) · [MDBList](https://mdblist.com) ### Notes - Content availability depends on your configured sources and their upstream services. - The Apple TV Simulator cannot play AV1. ## About This project began with the Nuvio mobile app as its foundation. Since then, the tvOS version has grown into one of the best user-configured media players for Apple TV: a native SwiftUI app with catalog browsing, profiles, search, library and watchlist features, and playback controls designed for the Siri Remote. The shared mobile code remains in [composeApp](./composeApp), alongside the iOS app in [iosApp](./iosApp). Active tvOS development happens in [tvosApp/NuvioTV](./tvosApp/NuvioTV). ## Current tvOS App Native SwiftUI Apple TV app with configurable catalogs; profile-scoped Nuvio libraries, Plex servers, Jellyfin libraries, and SMB shares; Calendar and follows; and Watch Party. Top Shelf supports configurable content in carousel, landscape, and poster layouts. Optional Seekr seek previews show frames near the playhead. Playback uses AetherEngine, with MPVKit for demanding cases; the app also supports native Usenet/NNTP playback. See the [tvOS source](./tvosApp/NuvioTV) and [Tuist project](./tvosApp/Project.swift). ## Contributing Contributions are welcome; see [CONTRIBUTING.md](./CONTRIBUTING.md). ## Development Requires macOS, Xcode with an Apple TV simulator runtime, tvOS 18 or later, [mise](https://mise.jdx.dev) (tool version pinned in `mise.toml`), [Tuist](https://tuist.dev), and network access. The Xcode project is generated from [tvosApp/Project.swift](./tvosApp/Project.swift). Clone with submodules and generate the workspace: ```bash git clone --recurse-submodules NuvioTVOS cd NuvioTVOS mise install (cd tvosApp && tuist generate) ``` With an Apple TV simulator booted, run `./scripts/run-mobile.sh tvos s` or build the `NuvioTV` scheme in Xcode. ## Configuration & Tests Login is optional during development; the default Nuvio backend is configured for QR and email login. Unit tests are in [NuvioTVTests](./tvosApp/NuvioTVTests) and run with `scripts/test-tvos.sh`; UI tests use the separate `NuvioTV-UI` scheme. See the [UI validation notes](./tvosApp/NuvioTVUITests/README.md). ## Built With - SwiftUI and UIKit focus/input bridging for tvOS - AetherEngine and MPVKit playback engines - Configurable catalog, source, and subtitle APIs - Kotlin Multiplatform / Compose Multiplatform code from the original mobile app ## Legal & DMCA Nuvio functions solely as a client-side interface for browsing metadata and playing media provided by user-configured sources. It is intended for content the user owns or is otherwise authorized to access. Nuvio is not affiliated with any third-party extensions, catalogs, sources, or content providers. It does not host, store, or distribute any media content. For comprehensive legal information, including the full disclaimer, third-party extension policy, and DMCA/Copyright information, visit the [Legal & Disclaimer Page](https://nuvioapp.space/legal).
